meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: 收到规划请求后，Claude 会先查文档、整理可用的 API，再按阶段给出实施计划；每阶段写清要做什么、参考哪些文档、如何验证，并提示别用文档里没有的写法。
howto.when: 当你要求规划一项功能、任务或多步实现，尤其是准备执行 do 之前，会触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一下这个功能，先查好文档再分阶段。
say.note: 先做文档发现，再给出带验证清单的分阶段计划。

say.text: 把这个任务拆成计划，每个阶段都标注验证方法。
say.note: 产出每阶段有验证步骤的实施计划。

say.text: 在执行之前，先给我一份具体的实施计划。
say.note: 会先查文档，避免凭空假设 API 用法。

howto.what_en: When asked to plan, Claude discovers documentation, lists allowed APIs, then outputs a phased implementation plan with doc references, verification steps, and anti-pattern warnings per phase.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation, especially before executing with do.

say_en.text: Help me plan this feature, first check docs then break into phases.
say_en.note: Claude runs doc discovery first, then gives a phased plan.

say_en.text: Turn this task into a plan with verification steps for each phase.
Before executing, give me a concrete implementation plan first.
say_en.note: Starts with documentation discovery to avoid assumed APIs.
